Read each file fully, then apply these specific fixes:

### 1. SkillsDetailPanel.tsx
- Change `CardHeader` padding from `pb-3 px-4 pt-4` to `px-5 py-4` for consistency
- Change CardContent padding to `px-5 pb-5 pt-0`
- Change progress bar from `h-2` to `h-2 rounded-full` (ensure rounded on both track and fill)

### 2. ExperiencePanel.tsx
- Standardize Card padding: change any `p-4`, `p-3` to `px-5 py-4`
- Change `text-[11px]` to `text-xs` throughout
- Ensure timeline connector line uses `bg-border` instead of any hardcoded color

### 3. EducationPanel.tsx

- Change `text-[11px]` to `text-xs` throughout
- Standardize Card padding to `px-5 py-4`
- Add `transition-colors` to Badge components

### 4. AuthenticityReport.tsx
- Fix dark mode: change `dark:bg-emerald-900/10` to `dark:bg-emerald-900/20` everywhere
- Fix dark mode: change `dark:bg-red-900/10` to `dark:bg-red-900/20` everywhere

- Change progress bar height from `h-1.5` to `h-2 rounded-full`
- Add `max-w-prose` to any long text paragraphs for readability
- Replace `text-[11px]` with `text-xs`

### 5. AINudgePanel.tsx
- Change padding from `p-3` to `p-4`
- Change `space-y-2` to `space-y-2.5`
- Change `gap-2` to `gap-2.5` for icon-text pairs
- Replace any `text-[11px]` with `text-xs`

### 6. CandidateNotesPanel.tsx
- Change `rounded-xl` on outer panel to `rounded-lg` for consistency with inner notes
- Change `max-h-64` to `max-h-80` for more visible notes
- Standardize note card spacing
- Replace `text-[11px]` with `text-xs` throughout
- Add `scrollbar-thin` class to the scrollable notes container if available, or just ensure `overflow-y-auto` is smooth

Do NOT change any component imports, props, or functionality. Only CSS/layout changes.
